item.summary: In a significant initiative towards realising Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi's vision of 'Sahkar se Samriddhi' and further strengthening, modernising and making the cooperative movement in the country more inclusive, Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today performed the Bhoomi Pujan for the revival of NHEC (National Heavy Engineering Cooperative) Multi-State…
item.title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah performs Bhoomi Pujan of NHEC Multi-State Cooperative Society, virtually inaugurates Western Regional Office of Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies and launches Bharat Taxi services in Pune, Maharashtra
